contract.edit: edit(value, false) changes draft immediately, then flush()
contract.concurrentWrite: active flush is shared; the save loop serializes the newer generation after the first acknowledgement
contract.latestFailure: confirmed remains the last acknowledged value; draft remains the failed newer value, dirty=true, error is retained
contract.retry: flush() retries the dirty draft and clears error while saving
contract.discard: refresh(true) reads the adapter and replaces draft/confirmed, clearing error
contract.incomingWhileDirtyOrSaving: receive(value) records the incoming identity but does not refresh while dirty/saving/action-pending
